Act as the implementation sub-agent for this task.

You are implementing ONE issue in the Email OS Vue/Tauri client (repo = your worktree). Read first: PRODUCT.md, DESIGN.md (esp. sections on the reader, buttons, naming "Do" rules), src/components/ReaderView.vue, src/assets/style.css (reader + header sections), src/App.vue (where the reader is mounted and the split-header is rendered).

## Shared rules (all reader-review tasks)
- Context: we compared our conversation reader against a Superhuman screenshot. Superhuman: the reader header carries icon-only quiet grey actions (back arrow at left; at right: done check, remind clock, prev/next chevrons); no text toolbar row. Our reader instead has a toolbar row of text buttons: `Close (Esc)`, `Files and links (⌘O)`, `Prepare reply`, a sentence "Reply targets the latest message from X", `Mark done (E)`, read-state controls (ReaderView.vue ~lines 215-277).
- Stay on-brand per PRODUCT.md/DESIGN.md: terse, honest-state, keyboard-first, no AI/sparkle features, no Superhuman scope import (no AI summary, no quick-reply chips, no share/mention composer). Message content must stay text-interpolated only (no v-html).
- Keep every existing `data-test` attribute, aria-label and keyboard behaviour working unless your issue explicitly changes it; update existing tests in tests/ (and src tests) that your change legitimately affects. Do NOT edit DESIGN.md or PRODUCT.md — instead put any needed design-doc notes in your final report; the parent will integrate them.
- Other agents are changing the same files in parallel on separate branches (issues: toolbar→header, collapsed snippets, body type/measure, Details/focus-ring dedupe, star status line, active-card style, recent-mail filter). Keep your diff MINIMAL and localized to reduce merge conflicts; do not refactor or reformat unrelated code.
- Setup: run `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` in your worktree. Verify with `pnpm typecheck` and `pnpm test` (run the full suite; report pass/fail honestly, including any pre-existing failures — check on a clean checkout of your base commit if something fails).
- Preview: `pnpm dev --port <PORT> --strictPort` (browser = in-memory fixture workspace). Open the dev URL with the preview tools (mcp__t3-code__preview_* via ToolSearch), resize to 1280x800, press Enter on the focused first row to open "Fixture thread 1: weekly status" (a 3-message thread). Stop your dev server and close your preview tab when done.
- Evidence: save PNGs/video under the evidence dir given below (mkdir -p it). Capture BEFORE (on base commit, before editing) and AFTER shots at 1280x800 using preview_snapshot with save=true (copy the resulting screenshotPath into your evidence dir with a clear name like before-reader.png / after-reader.png). Screenshots can be blurry at times; if so, retry or zoom via preview_evaluate scaling, and report geometry (getBoundingClientRect values) as supplementary evidence.
- Commit your work on your worktree's branch (do not push, do not open a PR). End the commit message with the line: `Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>`.
- Final report (brief): branch name + head SHA, files changed, what you did, tests run/results, evidence file absolute paths, any DESIGN.md notes for the parent, and anything you could not do.

## Your issue: P1 – Toolbar is Gmail-web clutter
Replace the text toolbar row with quiet icon-only actions in the reader header, like Superhuman. Specifically:
- When the reader is open, the header (see App.vue split-header; the reader currently shows the context h1 + preview badge + search/commands glyphs) should show a back-arrow button (replaces `Close (Esc)`), and right-aligned quiet icon buttons: Mark done / Mark not done (check glyph, keeps title 'Mark done (E)' style tooltip via actionLabel), Files and links (⌘O) glyph, Prepare reply glyph, read/unread toggle glyph where currently available, and previous/next conversation chevrons wired to the same behaviour as J/K (find how App.vue handles J/K; reuse, don't reimplement). Reuse the existing glyph components/style (HeaderGlyph.vue / PaneGlyph.vue) and add new glyph paths in the same style (16px, 1.5px stroke, icon-muted colour, text-primary on hover/focus).
- Each icon button MUST keep a visible-to-AT accessible name (aria-label / visually-hidden text) and a title tooltip including its shortcut; keep the existing data-test ids (reader-close, files-links, prepare-reply, reader-archive-toggle, reader-toggle-read, reader-selection-*, etc.) so tests keep finding them.
- Bulk-selection scoped controls ("Mark N done", "Mark N read"...) must stay explicit and count-labelled — keep those as text buttons (they are honest-state controls), but place them where they make sense (e.g. a quiet text line under the subject or in the header) without a full toolbar row.
- Move the "Reply targets the latest message from X" sentence out of the toolbar: show it as the tooltip/title of the reply button and as visually-hidden text; additionally only show it visibly when reply is disabled/blocked (existing `replyBlockedReason` notice already covers blocked).
- Remove the toolbar row and its bottom rule so the subject sits higher; subject should not move when buttons are disabled/in-flight (no layout shift).
- Respect narrow widths: header actions must not overflow at the existing breakpoints (check at ~1030px wide too).
- Evidence dir: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-sofianebebert-workspace-worktrees-email-os-t3-8289bc5f/c76d33d1-bfb7-485b-a7f9-1da77be42a31/scratchpad/evidence/p1-header-actions . PORT: 5201. Required: before + after screenshot at 1280x800, an after screenshot at 1030x800, one hover/tooltip or focus-ring screenshot on an icon button, AND a short screen recording (preview_recording_start / preview_recording_stop) showing: open thread → press J/K or click next/prev chevron → press E or click the done check (show result) → Esc/back arrow. Save the video path in your report.

content.text:
The reader toolbar row is gone. Its actions are now quiet icon buttons in the app header, and the subject sits about 40px higher (y 206 → 167 at 1280×800). Typecheck is clean and the full suite passes (701 passed, 32 skipped, 4 files skipped). One earlier full run had a composer test fail (`drafts.component.test.ts`, "retries a lost save…"); it passed in isolation and on the re-run, so I read it as timing under load.

**Branch / head:** `reader-icon-header-actions` @ `ea406ed`, committed and not pushed.

**Files changed:** `src/components/ReaderView.vue`, `src/App.vue`, `src/components/HeaderGlyph.vue`, `src/assets/style.css`, `tests/app.component.test.ts`, `tests/drafts.component.test.ts`.

**What changed**
- **Header actions:** `ReaderView` teleports its icon buttons into two new host spans in the app header. It falls back to inline rendering when no host is passed, so standalone reader tests still find every `data-test` id.
- **Back arrow:** it leads the context title, with its glyph on the 50px inset.
- **Right-aligned icons:** Mark done / not done, read/unread toggle, Files and links, Prepare reply, then previous/next chevrons, then the existing palette and search glyphs.
- **Accessibility and test ids:** each icon has hidden text carrying the old label, plus a title with its shortcut. All `data-test` ids are kept.
- **Chevrons:** K/J use an `@move` emit, handled by the existing `moveReaderConversation`, and App computes availability from `resolveReaderNeighbor`. They are disabled at the ends of the list and hidden in Activity, Reminders and Trash readers, where J/K do nothing.
- **Reply sentence:** it is now the reply button's title and a visually-hidden `reply-source-label`, linked by `aria-describedby`. The blocked-reply notice is unchanged.
- **Text controls:** read state, "Mark read/unread" (unknown state) and the count-labelled bulk controls ("Mark N done", "Mark N read"…) stay as text. They sit in one `reader-meta-row` line under the subject, which renders only when there is something to show.
- **No layout shift:** the toolbar row and its rule are removed, and disabled buttons keep their 32px slot.
- **Tests:** I added a test for the header icons and the prev/next chevrons, and updated the "prepares a reply" test to find the button from the app root, since it is no longer inside the reader article.

**Checks beyond the suite:** I clicked through the thread in the preview (next, prev, done, back). At 1030px the trail fits (search glyph right edge 742 against header right 758). At 640px nothing overflows, and the document is no wider than the window. The fixture workspace has read controls off, so the read-toggle glyph was not exercised visually. Native tooltips don't appear in screenshots, so the tooltip shot shows the focus ring and brightened glyph instead.

**Evidence** (all in `/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-sofianebebert-workspace-worktrees-email-os-t3-8289bc5f/c76d33d1-bfb7-485b-a7f9-1da77be42a31/scratchpad/evidence/p1-header-actions/`):
- `before-reader.png`
- `after-reader-1280.png`
- `after-reader-1030.png`
- `after-focus-hover-done.png`
- `after-flow-next-prev-done-back.mp4` (about 6 seconds: open, next, prev, next, done, back)

**Notes for the parent**
- **DESIGN.md:** the reader's actions now live in the split header, not a toolbar row. Reader actions are icon-only quiet glyphs (32px pitch, icon-muted, text-primary on hover/focus), each with a hidden text name and a title carrying its shortcut. Honest-state controls (read state, count-labelled bulk actions) stay as text under the subject. The existing `HeaderGlyph` stroke is 1.4px, not 1.5px, so I kept 1.4 for consistency.
- **Merge conflicts:** I touched the toolbar block and the subject/meta area in `ReaderView.vue`, and added two spans and four props in `App.vue`. Merging with the star status line and collapsed-snippet branches should conflict only near the subject.

**Not done:** there is no remind (clock) icon in the reader actions. The existing Reminders glyph in the header trail already covers it. Prev/next and K/J use `title` strings that I did not add to `browsingActions`, because that list feeds the command palette.
